guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：開放式無線接取網路
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Open radio-access networks
guides.concept: 以解耦無線元件、開放介面與閉迴路控制串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect disaggregated radio components, open interfaces and closed-loop control through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「解耦邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：元件解耦增加介面驗證與版本管理責任。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留功能切分，只改 fronthaul 延遲。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「O-RU 與 O-DU」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「前傳同步」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：前傳資料與時基需協同，容量足夠不代表同步足夠。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留功能切分，只改 fronthaul 延遲。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「管理平面」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Non-RT RIC」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：慢時間尺度政策與學習不能替代低層即時處理。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定 xApp 輸入，只改控制更新週期。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「xApp/rApp」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「A1 政策」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：政策意圖需要可驗證映射至可執行動作。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較兩供應商能力宣告重疊及缺項。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「雲端資源」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「安全邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：開放介面仍需相互驗證與最小權限。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬控制器斷線，觀察降階而非失控。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「互通能力」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「降階驗證」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：應用撤除時應保留可描述的基線服務。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬控制器斷線，觀察降階而非失控。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「解耦邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around disaggregation boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Disaggregation adds interface-verification and version-management responsibilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep the split and vary fronthaul delay. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat o-ru and o-du as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around fronthaul synchronization, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Fronthaul data and timing must cooperate; capacity does not prove synchronization. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep the split and vary fronthaul delay. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat management plane as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around non-real-time ric, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Slow-timescale policy/learning cannot replace low-layer real-time processing. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix xApp inputs and vary control update interval. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat xapps and rapps as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around a1 policies, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Policy intent needs a verifiable mapping to executable actions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare overlaps and omissions in two vendor capability declarations. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat cloud resources as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around security boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Open interfaces still need mutual authentication and least privilege. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model controller loss and verify degradation rather than uncontrolled action. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat interoperability capabilities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around fallback evidence, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Removing a control application should preserve a defined baseline service. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model controller loss and verify degradation rather than uncontrolled action. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat disaggregation boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「閉迴路穩定」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「降階驗證」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「降階驗證」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for closed-loop stability. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for fallback evidence. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for fallback evidence. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.
pitfalls: 所有 RIC 控制迴路均適合逐 OFDM 符號控制。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
pitfallsEn: Every RIC loop is suitable for per-OFDM-symbol control. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

guides.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
guides.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

courses.overview: 由解耦無線元件、開放介面與閉迴路控制連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect disaggregated radio components, open interfaces and closed-loop control to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 行動核心網路
related.why: 可移植「解耦邊界」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from disaggregation boundaries; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「解耦邊界」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from disaggregation boundaries; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理解耦無線元件、開放介面與閉迴路控制；「行動核心網路」主要處理5G 核心服務、控制／用戶平面與狀態，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes disaggregated radio components, open interfaces and closed-loop control; Mobile core networks emphasizes 5g core services, control/user planes and state. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「開放式無線接取網路」與「行動核心網路」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「管理平面」的對照方法至「服務式介面」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Open radio-access networks and Mobile core networks flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from management plane to service-based interfaces, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes disaggregated radio components, open interfaces and closed-loop control; Cellular base-station integration emphasizes base-station splits, rf metrics and synchronization. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「開放式無線接取網路」與「蜂巢式基地台整合」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「管理平面」的對照方法至「射頻鏈路」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Open radio-access networks and Cellular base-station integration flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from management plane to rf chain, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
